name: Transición del Cuello
algorithm: Neck Transition — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes the face-neck transition zone for deepfake detection:

1. **Transition Zone Identification**: The boundary region between the face (jaw, chin) and neck is identified. This transition zone is typically 20-50 pixels wide and is the most common artifact location for face-swap deepfakes.

2. **Gradiente Análisis**: The image gradient across the transition zone is measured. Natural face-neck transitions show smooth, anatomically motivated gradients: skin color gradation, shadow from the mandible, and texture transition from facial skin to neck skin. Deepfake blending produces characteristic gradient anomalies — either over-smoothed (Poisson blending) or showing color steps.

3. **Rendering Quality Discontinuity**: The effective resolution and detail level on either side of the transition is compared. Generated faces may have different rendering quality than the original neck — different noise patterns, different compression artifacts, or different texture granularity. These quality discontinuities at the transition indicate compositing.

4. **Anatomical Transition Verificación**: The face-neck transition should follow anatomical constraints: submental contour, hyoid region, sternocleidomastoid muscle visibility. The method checks whether surface geometry at the transition is anatomically correct. Deepfake blending may produce anatomically implausible neck-face junctions.

5. **Temporal Transition Seguimiento**: The transition zone characteristics are tracked across frames. Natural transitions remain anatomically consistent. Deepfake transitions may show varying artifact intensity — more visible at extreme head poses, during fast motion, or under challenging lighting — creating temporal variation in boundary quality.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante neck transition analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Li, Y. et al. (2020). Face X-ray for More General Face Forgery Detection. CVPR.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
